seo.title: Full-stack developer
seo.description: Karim Matar is a full-stack developer. He builds web apps with React and Next.js, and works on the server side with Laravel, PHP and Node.js. His projects are listed on this site.

hero.headlineAccessible: web apps, REST APIs, interfaces, realtime features and automation, from the database to the deployed site
hero.subtext: I build web apps end to end, from the data model and the API down to the interface.

projects.title: Projects I've built
projects.text: A mix of client work and personal projects. Open one to read more, or try the live site where there is one.

list.title: LexiPlay
list.description: A learning web app for children with dyslexia. New words are practised in five short games, with an OpenDyslexic font option and a parent dashboard that tracks progress.

list.title: Donation app
list.description: A donation page for De Warmste Week. Payments run through Mollie, each donation is stored and streamed to a live screen, and donors can get a confirmation by email.

list.title: Doodley
list.description: A real-time drawing and guessing game. One player draws while the others guess in a live chat; the faster the guess, the more it scores. Players join a room with a five-character code or a QR scan.

list.title: JobFalcon
list.description: A personal Telegram bot that searches UK software-engineering vacancies, checks each listing's own wording for visa sponsorship, and verifies employers against the official register of licensed sponsors. It runs scheduled searches and only alerts on new listings.

list.title: EnterIn
list.description: A walkable cinema built in Unreal Engine 5. Each door opens onto a short film-inspired experience, including a horror sequence based on Insidious. Built solo in a month, and awarded a prize by Artevelde University.

about.title: Database to interface
body: At Artevelde I studied programming, and graphic and digital media. I work on both sides of an app: the data model and the API on one side, the interface on the other.
I keep components small and consistent, reuse one set of colours and spacing, and build with accessibility in mind instead of adding it later.
Outside client work I build my own projects. This site is one of them: it's where I try out layout, motion and the three-language setup.
about.pullQuote: I like finishing a feature end to end, not stopping at the API.

meta.title: EnterIn · Unreal Engine 5 experiences
meta.description: EnterIn is a collection of movie-inspired experiences built in Unreal Engine 5 by Karim Matar in a single month in 2025. Walk through a cinema where each door opens onto a different film, including a horror experience inspired by Insidious. Awarded a prize by Artevelde University.

hero.title: EnterIn
hero.lead: A cinema you can walk through, where every door opens onto a different film.
hero.statement: I built EnterIn in a single month in 2025, with no game development experience at the time. It won a prize from Artevelde University.
hero.award: Awarded a prize by Artevelde University · 2025
